_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - this is a shape reference, not balance. What a run pays, and how much, is
DELIBERATELY NOT DECIDED YET (plan §2.20 fixed the shape and deferred the contents), so the
items and counts below are placeholders picked to show one of each schema feature. Nothing in
the mod pays this table: runs pay 'cobblemon_roguelite:default', and no such file ships.
Write your own at data/<your-namespace>/roguelite/payout_tables/<name>.json, or shadow this
path from your own datapack to delete this example.
Payouts are NOT currency (§2.20 - the mode charges currency to enter and has to stay a sink)
and are NOT rolled: every entry that matches the outcome and the depth pays, in order. The
randomness lives in the reward tables, inside the run.
Any field whose name starts with '_' is ignored, which is where comments go. Every other
unknown field is an error, so a typo is reported instead of silently taking a default.
_entries: outcomes is REQUIRED on every entry - one or more of: completed, wiped, abandoned. It has no
default because an omitted list would have to mean 'all of them', and would quietly pay a
wipe on wave 3 whatever a full clear pays. min_wave/max_wave are the depth reached.

entries._outcomes: Only a full clear pays this one.
A wipe still pays, but only from wave 50 down.

entries._max_wave: Bounded so it stops once the deeper entry above takes over, rather than stacking with it.
